model_annotation: The bar chart for Germany presents the consumption share of three base metals—aluminium, copper, and nickel—across three years, specifically 2021, 2022, and 2023. The vertical axis denotes percentage share, ranging from 0 to 30% with consistent linear intervals. Each base metal has a set of three bars in distinct colors, representing the respective year's data. Aluminium shows a declining trend in consumption share, from approximately 3.6% in 2021 to 2.7% in 2023. Copper consumption exhibits a significant increase, peaking at 25.1% in 2022 and then a slight decrease to 11.4% in 2023. Nickel displays minor fluctuations, with a peak at 24.7% in 2022 and a slight decrease to 11.4% in 2023. The UK's bar chart displays the consumption share of the same base metals, also for three years. Here, the vertical axis uses the same percentage scale, but the data values for 2023 seem to be incorrect, as 34.6 surpasses the axis' maximum limit of 30%, indicating a potential error in the chart.
